correctness.rationale: Normalize the first filled ellipse to the unit disk (area multiplier ab). The other has reciprocal singular semiaxes k*lambda and k/lambda, lambda-1/lambda=q|sin theta|, q=(a^2-b^2)/(ab). Comparing the minimum radial squares gives the stated exact polar integral and switch at lambda=k. Lambda increases from 1 to a/b; moving-boundary terms cancel in the derivative, proving strict area decrease on (theta_c,pi/2). Uniform rotation gives containment-atom mass 2 theta_c/pi and CDF 1-2theta(y)/pi. At first tangency lambda-k=L t+O(t^2), the lost cap is order (lambda-k)^(3/2) with the stated K, so the continuous probability tail is order epsilon^(2/3). Checked cases k=1, 1<k<a/b, k>=a/b and theta=0,pi/2; the change of exponent at k=1 is not conflated with positive-threshold behavior. Independent high-precision original-ellipse polar quadrature matches sampled formula values, and onset ratios for t=0.005,0.002,0.0005 approach 1 (0.98933,0.99571,0.99892). Numerical checks alone do not prove continuum claims.
